heading: Get $120 in summer food benefits for your child
title: Get $120 in summer food benefits for your child
body:
Each eligible child can receive **one $120 payment** for summer groceries.

Most eligible children get their payment automatically. Some need to submit an application. 

We can tell if you should apply for your child. Tap "Do I need to apply?" and enter your child's information.
accordionTitle: How do I know if my child can get Summer EBT?
body2: No matter their immigration status, any child could qualify for **one** of these reasons:
body3:
They are between ages 6 and 17.5. And they get SNAP (food stamps), Colorado Works (TANF), Medicaid, or the Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations (FDPIR)
Or they are temporarily unhoused or in foster care
Or they get free or low-cost meals at school
Or they are enrolled in a school that participates in the National School Lunch Program (NSLP)
body4:
Children may be automatically enrolled if we have enough information to confirm their eligibility. 

If not, parents or guardians can apply to see if they qualify. Tap ["Do I need to apply?"](link) to find out if you should apply for your child.
